row.category: Vertical SaaS (Healthcare, Education, Real Estate, Construction, Field Service)
row.evidence: MasterControl's pricing page says "Contact our representatives for information about pricing tailored to your organization's needs"; no public MasterControl page documents SSO, SCIM or user provisioning.
row.notes: New row (MasterControl quality, manufacturing and asset software for life sciences). Quote-only, named-user licences, packages chosen with sales. No public help centre or product documentation: help.mastercontrol.com serves an image, and the API Toolkit data sheet and getting-started guide sit behind a download form. Neither the marketing sitemap (about 3,000 URLs) nor the resource centre mentions SCIM, SSO or provisioning. Okta's MasterControl app is SWA (password vaulting) only. No Entra tutorial was found and JumpCloud's page returned 403. Left unknown rather than none because the product docs are not public.

user_api.notes: MasterControl offers an API Toolkit for customer-built integrations, but its documentation is gated behind a form; whether it covers users or roles is unknown.
